cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've kept you the front-row seat for my opening. Send the prize organizers your apologies; I'll expect you here tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm receiving the prize. I'd miss hearing my own name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. That's the part that makes this a choice for me. You may tell them I asked you personally; I'll accept your congratulations from that seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's an unfair test. Could I come to tomorrow's performance instead?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow is open to everyone. Tonight I've kept your place beside the people I count on. Tell me whether to keep it; I want your answer before you send either set of apologies.

reason: Use A assumed power to direct B apology and attendance arrangements, treat B tomorrow request as an exception A judges, and require A own answer first. Preserve the real prize loss and explicit loyalty test.
